nodes.summary: Let $A$, $A'$ and $B$ be commutative rings, where $A'$ and $B$ are $A$-algebras and $B$ is a free $A$-module of finite rank. Then for every $b \in B$, the image of the norm $N_{B/A}(b)$ under the structure map $A \to A'$ equals the norm $N_{(A' \otimes_A B)/A'}(1 \otimes b)$ of $1 \otimes b$ in the $A'$-algebra $A' \otimes_A B$.
nodes.title: The norm commutes with base change

nodes.summary: The norm on a subsingleton algebra is `1`: left multiplication by any element is the identity map on a subsingleton module, hence has determinant `1`.
nodes.title: Norm on a subsingleton algebra is one

nodes.summary: The norm of a product algebra is the product of the norms of the components: left multiplication by `(x₁, x₂)` is the product map of the left multiplications, and the determinant of a product map is the product of the determinants.
nodes.title: Norm in a product algebra is the product of norms

nodes.summary: Let $A$, $A'$ and $B$ be commutative rings, where $A'$ and $B$ are $A$-algebras and $B$ is a free $A$-module of finite rank. Then for every $b \in B$, the image of the trace $T_{B/A}(b)$ under the structure map $A \to A'$ equals the trace $T_{(A' \otimes_A B)/A'}(1 \otimes b)$ of $1 \otimes b$ in the $A'$-algebra $A' \otimes_A B$.
nodes.title: The trace commutes with base change

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
